entries.note: Tian 1997 (PMID 9301479, DOI resolves) abstract carries the +71% outflow sentence verbatim. No patient outflow/engagement measure exists: Myers 2016 measured Goldmann IOP only; Li 2018 facility data are mouse. untested holds.

Quote is Tian 1997 abstract sentence 1, verbatim. Judgement facts checked: Myers 2016 'no apparent plateau' to 500 mcg; NCT02565173 arms 3%/6% QD, 4.5% BID; Li 2018 3% 2.44 vs 6% 2.45 mmHg; Qiu 2021 abstract blames dose/regimen. untested holds.

Tian 1997 abstract verbatim (exactly 40 words): rise 4.9/3.5 mmHg at 30 min, fall 2.1/3.6 mmHg at 2-6 h. Myers 2016 cites Tian plus Crosson 1992-96 rabbit/cat and Avila 2001 mouse for the class, so monkey proxy model is right.

Myers 2016 full text (PMC5069706): the animal-model sentence is background citing Tian/Crosson/Avila; Discussion never relates patient IOP to animals. Juxtaposition, so comparison_stated=false. First stated comparison is Li 2018 'Like CHA, trabodenoson effectively lowers IOP in several animal species, including humans' (direction only).

DMPX sentence verbatim in Tian 1997. Crosson 1996 (PMID 8759351) abstract: CV-1808 raised rabbit IOP max +15.6 mmHg, cat +8.1, DMPX-blocked, blood-aqueous barrier breakdown. Konno 2007 A2A vasodilation, Laties single hyperaemia, Myers 16/85 and 11.8% baseline imbalance all confirmed. untested holds.

text_corrections: efficacy[1].judgement: 'no dose beat placebo at any of 12 time points' is wrong. Inotek 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (3 Jan 2017, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001281895/000119312517000341/d320382dex991.htm): primary endpoint was superiority at ALL 12 time points and was not achieved; 6%/2000 mcg QD was statistically superior to placebo at Days 14, 42, 84 in daily IOP change; only the 8 AM time point failed for every dose. 4.25 / 2.38 / 5.29 mmHg (6% QD / placebo / timolol) and n=303 are correct.

efficacy[1].judgement: the 8-K attributes the miss to a placebo response 2-3 mmHg larger than Phase 2 (and the Raber meta-analysis), not to dose or regimen; dose/regimen is Qiu 2021's reading (review, abstract only; full text 403). Hallaj 2021 (doi:10.1016/j.lfs.2021.119796, review) mislabels MATrX-1 as a non-inferiority failure; do not cite it.

efficacy[1].magnitude 'within_2x' is the drafter's own arithmetic (monkey 2.1-3.6 vs patient placebo-adjusted 2.5 mmHg); no source compares magnitudes. If the cell moves to Li 2018 it should read 'direction_only' with source_calls_it='match'.

context.mechanism: manifest names this context 'ADORA2A agonists'; the draft widened it to 'Adenosine receptor agonists for IOP lowering' and every patient-side datum is the A1 agonist trabodenoson. The note discloses it but the mechanism field and tile label do not; the two A2A agonists have zero ophthalmic PubMed records (OPA-6566, ATL-313, DE-112 with glaucoma/IOP/ophthalmic terms: 0 hits) and no posted results on NCT01410188 or NCT01279083.
missing: Li 2018 (doi:10.1167/iovs.17-23212, IOVS, PMC5774255) as the efficacy `same` source: it is the only primary paper that itself states animal-human agreement for trabodenoson; the draft relegated it to a judgement note. Model should read 'several animal species (mouse measured; monkey/rabbit via ARVO abstracts)'.

SEC Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (Inotek, 3 Jan 2017) should be cited as the durable location of the MATrX-1 numbers instead of 'press release and trade coverage'; under rule 1 it still cannot carry a status entry (not peer-reviewed, FDA or registry).

Qiu 2021 abstract refers to TWO pivotal Phase 3 failures; the draft covers only MATrX-1. The second (trabodenoson + latanoprost adjunct study) was not checked within budget; its registry record should be looked up for has_results.

registry_date for the Phase 2 comparison trial (Myers 2016) is null in the draft; the NCT identifier is stripped in the PMC rendering and was not looked up (budget). Brief rule 7 makes this lookup mandatory.

If the context stays ADORA2A: the A2A animal models disagree with each other (Crosson 1996 rabbit/cat A2 agonists raise IOP; Konno 2005/2007 A2A agonist 2-CN-Ado lowers IOP and raises ocular blood flow in rabbits). That split, with no patient data, would be the whole story and every cell would be untested on Konno/Crosson, not on Tian A1 proxies.
rule_questions: Does a one-sentence cross-species agreement statement in a primary paper's introduction (Li 2018: 'lowers IOP in several animal species, including humans') count as a 'published comparison' for `same`? If not, efficacy stays untested for the whole strip, because Myers 2016 never relates its patient result to the animal data.

Does an SEC-filed press release (8-K Exhibit 99.1, legally attested, with per-arm mmHg) qualify as a primary source under rule 1? Registry has no results, PubMed has no Phase 3 paper, only reviews discuss it. Under the brief as written the cell must stay `same`. Note that even if admitted, MATrX-1 is a direction match with a stringent all-12-time-points miss and a high placebo response, not a model contradiction, so `contra` would be wrong on substance too.

Context definition: the manifest says ADORA2A agonists but the only drug with patient data is an A1 agonist. Either rename the context (adenosine A1 agonists / trabodenoson) and update the manifest, or keep ADORA2A and rebuild with Konno/Crosson models and all cells untested. The brief does not say which; the drafter chose a third option (widen the class) without changing the manifest.
